title: The HIMACHAL PRADESH BOVINE BREEDING ACT, 2019
full_text: The HIMACHAL PRADESH BOVINE BREEDING ACT, 2019 हिमाचल प्रदेश गोजातीय प्रजनन अधिनियम, 2019 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20197 Act Number: 7 Enactment Date: 2019-04-24 Act Year: 2019 Short Title: The HIMACHAL PRADESH BOVINE BREEDING ACT, 2019 Hindi Title: हिमाचल प्रदेश गोजातीय प्रजनन अधिनियम, 2019 Long Title: An Act to provide for improvement of bovines by regulating bovine breeding activities including use of bovine breeding bulls for production of bovine semen, processing, storage, sale and distribution of bovine semen, and artificial insemination and any other breeding activity in bovines in the State of Himachal Pradesh and for the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
